description.zh: 迁移或同步任务ID，可调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)查询。
description.en: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.

description.zh:
升级后的实例规格，可以调用[DescribeDtsJobDetail](~~208925~~)查询升级前的实例规格。

- 迁移实例支持的规格：**xxlarge**、**xlarge**、**large**、**medium**、**small**。
- 同步实例支持的规格：**large**、**medium**、**small**、**micro**。

> 关于各链路规格的说明及性能测试情况请参见[数据迁移链路规格说明](~~26606~~)和[数据同步链路规格说明](~~26605~~)。
description.en:
The instance specifications after the upgrade. You can call [DescribeDtsJobDetail](~~208925~~) to query the instance specifications before the upgrade.

- Specifications supported by data migration instances: **xxlarge**, **xlarge**, **large**, **medium**, and **small**.
- Specifications supported by data synchronization instances: **large**, **medium**, **small**, and **micro**.

> For more information about the description and performance test results of each specification, see [Specifications of data migration instances](~~26606~~) and [Specifications of data synchronization instances](~~26605~~).

description.zh: DTS实例所在地域的ID，请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

title.en: Upgrade or downgrade DTS instance specifications

descriptions.zh:
> - DTS实例规格已不支持降级。
- 若DTS实例的源端为Redis 6.0版本且有增量数据更新，请勿执行升级操作，否则可能会导致DTS实例失败且无法恢复（失败后需要重新配置实例）。
descriptions.en:
> - Downgrading DTS instance specifications is no longer supported.
- If the source of a DTS instance is Redis 6.0 and incremental data updates exist, do not perform an upgrade. Otherwise, the DTS instance may fail and cannot be recovered. You must reconfigure the instance after a failure.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts transfer-instance-class --order-type UPGRADE --instance-class large --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-job-id r4yr723m1990000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --database-count 1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts TransferInstanceClass --region cn-hangzhou --OrderType UPGRADE --DtsJobId r4yr723m1990000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --DatabaseCount 1 --InstanceClass large --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
